newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar and weakened against the pound on Wednesday, reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean rate of 20.5695 against the dollar from 20.6275 on Tuesday. On the pound, the rupee traded at a mean commercial rate of 33.593 from 33.5135 on Tuesday.

Foreign exchange dealers said the rupee's fixing on was done in line with the dollar's weakening in overnight foreign exchange markets. Dealers added that some commercial banks still had a shortage of hard currency.
